title: Hydrogen-like Li²⁺
caption: With one electron and Z = 3, the energies are Z² = 9 times hydrogen's: E_n = −13.6 × 9 / n² eV. The n = 2 → 1 photon carries 91.8 eV, so λ = 13.5 nm, one ninth of hydrogen's 121.5 nm Lyman-α, deep in the ultraviolet.
alt: Energy levels of the lithium 2+ ion at minus 122.4, minus 30.6, minus 13.6 and minus 7.7 electronvolts, with the 2 to 1 transition at 13.5 nanometres.
